source: 150-RESEARCH.md section 6 (sub-tables 6.1 carbocyclic, 6.2 mancude heterocycle, 6.3 saturated heterocycle, 6.4 von Baeyer, 6.5 deprecated) + carry-forward from _OPSIN_NON_PIN_EXCLUSIONS per CONTEXT CD-02. Citations point to the QMUL Blue Book (https://iupac.qmul.ac.uk/BlueBook).

entries.name: benzene
entries.note: PIN for the simplest aromatic carbocycle

entries.name: toluene
entries.note: PIN; methylbenzene also acceptable but toluene is the retained PIN

entries.name: xylene
entries.note: 1,2- (ortho), 1,3- (meta) or 1,4- (para) isomers; retained PIN for dimethylbenzene

entries.name: naphthalene
entries.note: Retained PIN for fused bicyclic aromatic

entries.name: anthracene
entries.note: Retained PIN for ortho-fused tricyclic aromatic

entries.name: phenanthrene
entries.note: Retained PIN for angular ortho-fused tricyclic aromatic

entries.name: pyrene
entries.note: Retained PIN for peri-fused tetracyclic aromatic

entries.name: chrysene
entries.note: Retained PIN for ortho-fused tetracyclic aromatic

entries.name: pentacene
entries.note: Retained PIN for linear pentacyclic aromatic

entries.name: perylene
entries.note: Retained PIN for peri-fused pentacyclic aromatic

entries.name: acenaphthylene
entries.note: Retained PIN; partially saturated peri-fused tricyclic aromatic

entries.name: acenaphthene
entries.note: Retained PIN; dihydroacenaphthylene

entries.name: fluorene
entries.note: Retained PIN; 9H-fluorene is the standard PIN form

entries.name: indene
entries.note: Retained PIN; 1H-indene is the standard PIN form

entries.name: indane
entries.note: NOT PIN - PIN is 2,3-dihydro-1H-indene per P-22.1.3

entries.name: mesitylene
entries.note: NOT PIN - PIN is 1,3,5-trimethylbenzene per P-22.1.3

entries.name: cumene
entries.note: NOT PIN - cumene/cymene not retained per P-22.1.3

entries.name: cymene
entries.note: NOT PIN per P-22.1.3

entries.name: prismane
entries.note: DEPRECATED - replaced by tetracyclo[2.2.0.0(2,6).0(3,5)]hexane systematic name per P-23.7

entries.name: furan
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN

entries.name: thiophene
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN

entries.name: pyrrole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1H-pyrrole is standard

entries.name: imidazole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1H-imidazole is standard

entries.name: pyrazole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1H-pyrazole is standard

entries.name: oxazole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,3-oxazole

entries.name: isoxazole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,2-oxazole

entries.name: thiazole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,3-thiazole

entries.name: isothiazole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,2-thiazole

entries.name: pyran
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 2H-pyran is standard

entries.name: pyridine
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN

entries.name: pyridazine
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,2-diazine

entries.name: pyrimidine
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,3-diazine

entries.name: pyrazine
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1,4-diazine

entries.name: acridine
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN

entries.name: quinoline
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; benzo-fused pyridine

entries.name: isoquinoline
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 2-azanaphthalene

entries.name: indole
entries.note: Mancude heterocycle PIN; 1H-indole is standard

entries.name: purine
entries.note: Bare 'purine' not PIN per P-25.3.1.3; indicated H is required (7H-purine or 9H-purine). Promoted to deny so Orthonym's heterocycle/systematic handler produces the canonical PIN form. CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: pyrrolidine
entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.name: morpholine
entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.name: piperidine
entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.name: piperazine
entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.name: selenomorpholine
entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.note: Saturated heterocycle PIN

entries.name: adamantane
entries.note: Retained von Baeyer PIN; tricyclo[3.3.1.1(3,7)]decane is the systematic equivalent

entries.name: cubane
entries.note: Retained von Baeyer PIN; pentacyclo[4.2.0.0(2,5).0(3,8).0(4,7)]octane systematic

entries.name: quinuclidine
entries.note: NOT PIN - PIN is 1-azabicyclo[2.2.2]octane per P-23.7

entries.name: alane
entries.note: DEPRECATED - replaced by alumane per P-21.1.1.1

entries.name: aluminane
entries.note: Aluminum-containing 6-membered ring stem; not a PIN per P-21.1.1.1

entries.name: sulfurane
entries.note: Tetracoordinate sulfur stem; not a PIN per P-21.1.2.1

entries.name: iodinane
entries.note: Tricoordinate iodine stem; not a PIN per P-21.1.2.1

entries.name: [6]annulene
entries.note: Not recommended; use benzene per P-22.1.2

entries.name: azine
entries.note: Must NOT be used for pyridine per P-22.2.1 Table 2.2 note; ambiguous between azine and pyridine

entries.name: oxine
entries.note: Must NOT be used for pyran per P-22.2.1 Table 2.2 note

entries.name: ethylene
entries.note: Substituent-form non-PIN; PIN is ethene

entries.name: propylene
entries.note: Substituent-form non-PIN; PIN is propene

entries.name: acetylene
entries.note: Substituent-form non-PIN; PIN is ethyne

entries.name: isobutylene
entries.note: Substituent-form non-PIN; PIN is 2-methylpropene; carry-forward from _OPSIN_NON_PIN_EXCLUSIONS per CD-02

entries.name: phenetol
entries.note: Trivial name; PIN is ethoxybenzene per substitutive nomenclature P-66.6.3. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (canary CHANGED: ethoxybenzene -> phenetol)

entries.name: dimethylacetamide
entries.note: Trivial name lacks N,N- locants required for PIN; PIN is N,N-dimethylacetamide. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: dihydrosuccinate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is butanedioic acid per P-65.1.1. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: hydrolactate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 2-hydroxypropanoic acid (or lactic acid). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: crotonylene
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is but-2-yne. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: propione
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is pentan-3-one (substitutive). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: dimethylurea
entries.note: Trivial name lacks N,N'- locants required for PIN; PIN is N,N'-dimethylurea. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: isophorone
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 3,5,5-trimethylcyclohex-2-en-1-one. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (canary)

entries.name: dihydromaleate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is (2Z)-but-2-enedioic acid. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (canary)

entries.name: monoethanolamine
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 2-aminoethan-1-ol. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (canary)

entries.name: citronellyl pentanoate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 3,7-dimethyloct-6-en-1-yl pentanoate. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (canary)

entries.name: mesitylenic acid
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 3,5-dimethylbenzoic acid (substitutive). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: carbazole
entries.note: Bare 'carbazole' not PIN; PIN is 9H-carbazole with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3. Promoted to deny so Orthonym's heterocycle handler emits the indicated-H form. CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: indazole
entries.note: Bare 'indazole' not PIN; PIN is 1H-indazole per P-25.3.1.3. Promoted to deny so Orthonym's heterocycle handler emits the indicated-H form. CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: dihydrofumarate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is (2E)-but-2-enedioic acid. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: dihydrosulfate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is sulfuric acid. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: hydroastatic acid
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is astatane (or appropriate hydride name). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: 2'-adenylic acid
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; nucleotide PIN is full systematic adenosine 2'-(dihydrogen phosphate). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: 3'-adenylic acid
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; nucleotide PIN is full systematic adenosine 3'-(dihydrogen phosphate). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: 5'-adenylic acid
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; nucleotide PIN is full systematic adenosine 5'-(dihydrogen phosphate). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: biguanide
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 1-(diaminomethylidene)guanidine. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (substituent biguanidyl appearance).

entries.name: chromene
entries.note: Bare 'chromene' not PIN; PIN is 2H-chromene with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3. Phase 149 byte-identical lock requires indicated-H form.

entries.name: thiochromene
entries.note: Bare 'thiochromene' not PIN; PIN is 2H-isothiochromene with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3.

entries.name: perimidine
entries.note: Bare 'perimidine' not PIN; PIN is 1H-perimidine with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3.

entries.name: indan
entries.note: Bare 'indan' is OPSIN stem; HC retained name is 'indane'. Phase 149 byte-identical lock requires 'indane' form.

entries.name: phenoxazine
entries.note: Bare 'phenoxazine' not PIN; PIN is 10H-phenoxazine with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3.

entries.name: phenothiazine
entries.note: Bare 'phenothiazine' not PIN; PIN is 10H-phenothiazine with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3.

entries.name: betacarboline
entries.note: Bare 'betacarboline' not PIN; PIN is 9H-beta-carboline with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3 (also: hyphen and 'beta' formatting).

entries.name: isoindol
entries.note: Stem missing -e; PIN is 1H-isoindole with indicated hydrogen per P-25.3.1.3.

entries.name: piazthiol
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 2,1,3-benzothiadiazole per Hantzsch-Widman fusion nomenclature.

entries.name: phthalazine
entries.note: OPSIN data assigns 'phthalazine' to c1ccc2cnncc2c1 SMILES; PIN for that SMILES is cinnoline. Promoted to deny so SMILES-keyed lookup misses and systematic naming runs.

entries.name: cinnoline
entries.note: OPSIN data assigns 'cinnoline' to c1ccc2nnccc2c1 SMILES; PIN for that SMILES is phthalazine. Promoted to deny so SMILES-keyed lookup misses and systematic naming runs.

entries.name: glycerone
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 1,3-dihydroxypropan-2-one (substitutive). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage (existing test_opsin_merge_layer stems guard).

entries.name: citronellol
entries.note: OPSIN trivial; ester handler derives 'citronellyl' substituent from this entry, which conflicts with Phase 149 canary lock expecting systematic '3,7-dimethyloct-6-en-1-yl'. Promoted to deny so substituent naming uses systematic form. CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: paracetamol
entries.note: Pharmacological trivial name; PIN is N-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetamide per substitutive nomenclature. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: skatol
entries.note: OPSIN stem; PIN is 3-methyl-1H-indole per substitutive nomenclature. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: skatole
entries.note: Trivial name; PIN is 3-methyl-1H-indole. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: isobenzothiofuran
entries.note: OPSIN trivial; PIN is benzo[c]thiophene per fusion nomenclature. Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.

entries.name: trihydrocitrate
entries.note: Non-PIN trivial; PIN is 2-hydroxypropane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid (citric acid is HC retained). Promoted to deny per CONTEXT D-05 RT regression triage.
